$description: Day theme (light). Same keys as night.tokens.json.

maroon-edge.$description: Maroon as an outline: the border of maroon-toned cards, stats and bands. Lifts to a lighter maroon on Night so it still shows (3.5:1 on surface).

surface-sunk.$description: Wells, table stripes and quiet section backgrounds. A true grey, never tinted.

surface-raised.$description: Small lifts: a hovered tab, menus and dialogs. Cards and panels stay on surface and are drawn by their outline, in both themes.

fill-hover.$description: Hover wash behind neutral controls: secondary and ghost buttons, nav items, menu rows.

fill-pressed.$description: Pressed wash behind neutral controls, one step past fill-hover.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons on every surface and tint. A neutral near-black (17:1+ on Day surfaces).

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text: intros, hints, metadata. Neutral grey, 6.1:1+ on Day surfaces.

ink-disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls. Deliberately below 4.5:1; never use it for anything a person must read.

line.$description: Decorative hairlines and the 2px outline of neutral cards and panels. Neutral grey. Never the only boundary of a control.

line-control.$description: Input and checkbox borders at rest. 3.1:1+ on Day surfaces.

line-strong.$description: Hover border on cards, secondary button border, the selected tab rule.

action.$description: Primary button fill. Maroon on Day, yellow on Night.

action-hover.$description: Primary button fill on hover and press.

action-pressed.$description: Primary button while pressed: one step past hover.

on-action.$description: Text and icons on `action` (15.2:1 Day, 9.5:1 Night).

selected.$description: Where you are: the active tab and nav item. A plume wash, never the action fill, so a selected item never reads as a button.

on-selected.$description: Text and icons on selected (14:1 Day, 8.7:1 Night).

link.$description: Inline links on any surface (6.2:1 Day, 7:1+ Night). Underlined, always.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px gap in the surface color. 6:1 on Day surfaces, 11:1+ on Night.

success.$description: Success text and icons on surfaces and on tint-green.

danger.$description: Error text, icons and destructive actions on surfaces and on tint-red.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on surfaces and on tint-yellow (5:1+).

tint-yellow.$description: Highlight wash: warning notices, selected rows, the new-item tag.

tint-red.$description: Wash behind error notices and soft red tags. Ink on it 15:1+.

tint-green.$description: Wash behind success notices and soft green tags.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Cards on the page use borders, not shadows.
